register.negative_controls: No parent_of, sibling_of or spouse_of edge is evidenced. A parent deed is not a person. No evidence transposes Emmett to Flint or Orla to Alder. Correspondence, witnessing, certification, custody, clerical and advisory work, meeting arrangements and an expense remit do not create trust office, general agency, object status or power to receive another person's distribution. These are limits of proof, not findings that unrecorded relationships cannot exist.

The no-change clause also supports authority at the March delivery. Her own booking, ordering and cut-off instructions clarify procedure and expressly authorise no payment.

Tess Arnay's certified selected clauses to Kit Wenslow report one lodged Alder deed. Direct support for Ellis, Ione and Emmett; original office only for Nell and Tobin. Essential parent identity, power and delivery method for Rhea. The extract and its certification are not independent deed origins; the schedule is omitted.

Bram Lerrit's extract to Kit Wenslow reports a different lodged deed, with schedules omitted. Direct support for Cora, Ione and Orla; original office only for Nell and Tobin. PD-6894-R tests and excludes the Flint reading of the handover. Similar clauses are not a copy of the Alder exercise of power.

Alys Morcant checked the signed paper; Della Pennick attended and witnessed both signatures. The reproduced designation and its transcript certificate share one execution origin. Identifies Rhea and SD-Q7M2, not the destination or actual delivery. No stand-alone edge; no removal, property appointment or payment.

Gideon Sarn recorded the handover he attended and certified only that register entry. The extract is not a second account of delivery. The handover is an origin distinct from the signing-room transcript: it joins the exact instrument and parent references and records immediate release into custody, but does not identify Rhea or establish June office. No stand-alone edge.

Ione reports her own request and permission. Neither addressing Nell and Tobin nor mentioning either deed independently establishes any scored role. No payment decision, general mandate, kinship or proof of the current estimate.

Una reports an operating-account reimbursement and a separate unsupported claim. The underlying slip is reported attached to the claim; the print receipt was not received. No trust recharge or distribution instruction for EX-K4. No scored edge.
